info.name: VLC Media Player
info.description:
The main point of any addon style is to get away from a bright white background for the sake of less eye strain. Why do they always make pages as if we're printing on paper out here!?

This sytle is specifically for VLC's built-in browser-based media player, as the title suggests. The URL is what I will be using locally with the port number given to me from Ask Brave when I was seeking how to set up the command line options.
